smoke.notes: Repo's own negative-control selftest: 54 cases, 0 escapes (S1 tamper sweep 49/49, S2-S6 fail-closed). Cheapest runnable in-repo suite. Honest negatives: (1) the main gate suite `node tests/run_tests.mjs` is NOT_RUN here — it requires sibling repo quilt-stone/stone.mjs which is not present in this workspace (quilt-stone absent from /home/z/my-project); tests/receipt.json records a prior full green run with kernel sha ef9a3bba… sealed. (2) Inline dog-food of the kernel itself (my own scratch harness, no repo writes): 260/260 — 256/256 pack/unpack round-trip, vectorPass hand fixture {re:8,im:30}, 20-tick determinism between twin substrates, d in [0,63], tau frozen across tick. First harness run had my own seed-reuse bug (one PRNG consumed across two substrates) — fixed before recording.

essence: One-byte ternary hyper-embedding: 6-bit spatial amplitude + 2-bit timbre, integer-exact kernel with wormhole mechanics and pre-registered gates.

ideas.name: The packed byte primitive (data is geometry, control is physics)
ideas.statement: A single byte splits into two planes: 6 bits of spatial amplitude d in [0,63] and 2 bits of timbre tau over {Ground, Attract, Repel, Abstain}, with the operator map Psi = [0, +1, -1, 'i'] and an exact split-channel vector pass — no floats anywhere in LAYER 0.

ideas.name: The 64-slot wormhole table as compile-time blueprint
ideas.statement: Abstain cells read/write a fixed 64-slot table: a twin hit on a different (x,y) with nonzero resonance injects resonance*sigma into the pressure (the imaginary channel entering through the only free degree of freedom), writes are last-writer-wins, and nobody resonates with their own write.

ideas.name: Deterministic Moore-8 tick with frozen timbre
ideas.statement: One synchronous, toroidal, double-buffered tick: neighbors read from the pre-tick snapshot, Attract/Repel accumulate signed d into pressure, data moves by a pure saturation rule toward 63 or 0, and tau never changes inside tick — same substrate plus same tick count is byte-identical, always.

ideas.name: Pre-registered gates and stone receipts with honest failure
ideas.statement: Every gate's prediction is written before the run, observed numbers seal into a stone-v1 chain, a wrong prediction (G4's hand-arithmetic error) is kept forever by letter with the correction checked post-hoc, and an independent two-reader proves the chain fails closed at the tampered row.

parts.name: pack/unpack bijection over one byte
parts.essence: c <-> (tau, d) is an exact bijection onto {0..3} x {0..63}; bit 7-6 tau, bit 5-0 d.
parts.gate: 256/256 values round-trip exact AND 256 distinct packed outputs (gate G1)
parts.failure_mode: any overlap or lossy round-trip would break every downstream trace hash

parts.name: Psi operator map
parts.essence: The timbre-to-operator character table {0:0, 1:+1, 2:-1, 3:'i'} — Ground contributes to nothing, Attract amplifies, Repel inverts, Abstain is the looking-glass.
parts.gate: PSI === [0, 1, -1, 'i'] asserted by G1

parts.name: split-channel vector pass (integer-exact)
parts.essence: y_j^R = sum(Attract d*x) - sum(Repel d*x), y_j^I = sum(Abstain d*x); Ground excluded even with d>0; no floats in LAYER 0.
parts.gate: hand-computed fixtures exact and every output Number.isInteger (G4: row0 [A10,R4,I6,G63] x xs[2,3,5,7] -> {re:8, im:30})
parts.failure_mode: float leakage or a wrong channel assignment would fail the literal fixtures

parts.name: substrate allocation with named expandos
parts.essence: makeSubstrate returns a Uint8Array carrying w, h, ticks, __wormholes and bytes as named properties; serialize via traceView, never JSON.stringify.
parts.gate: w, h positive integers else RangeError
parts.failure_mode: JSON.stringify would leak expandos into traces (receipted as R5)

parts.name: 64-slot wormhole table
parts.essence: Static allocation, zero runtime discovery: slot s is empty or {x, y, resonance}; sigma parameter default log2(3).
parts.gate: exactly SLOT_COUNT=64 slots; write outside [0,64) throws RangeError

parts.name: twin-resonance read guard
parts.essence: An Abstain cell with data d reads slot d live; a hit counts only if the occupant is a different (x,y) with resonance != 0; the term resonance*sigma is added to pressure and emitted as an event.
parts.gate: lone Abstain cell never twins after its own first write; every event term === log2(3) exactly (G5 schedule)
parts.failure_mode: self-resonance (same x,y) or resonance=0 would make single cells self-excite

parts.name: wormhole write, last-writer-wins
parts.essence: After pressure, an Abstain cell writes its own (x, y) and resonance = |real_acc| + 1 to slot d; collisions resolve last-writer-wins while live reads keep same-slot twins mutually audible.
parts.gate: totalWrites = 12 after the G5 6-tick twin fixture

parts.name: sigma bridge scale policy
parts.essence: sigma defaults to log2(3) but is a swept parameter: with sigma~1.585 a lone twin flips exactly one unit of net-negative pressure, so the C3 sweep is a real dynamics sweep, not decoration.
parts.gate: the SPEC prices sigma as OPEN: only the sweep {log2(3), 0.5, 1, 2, 4} decides (C3); the gifted 'proof' is receipted as decorative
parts.failure_mode: treating log2(3) as proven would be LARP; SPEC.md receipted it as decorative

parts.name: pre-tick snapshot double buffer
parts.essence: Neighbors are always read from the pre-tick grid so in-place update stays synchronous-exact (interpretation receipt R2/R6).
parts.gate: tick mutates in place and returns the same substrate with synchronous-exact semantics

parts.name: Moore-8 branchless real accumulator
parts.essence: Eight toroidal neighbor reads in fixed order: Attract adds d, Repel subtracts d into the real accumulator; fixed order is what makes the wormhole live-read deterministic.
parts.gate: G2 full-tick exhaustion: 3840/3840 cell-updates in bounds with tau preserved

parts.name: nextD saturation rule
parts.essence: Pure rule table: net-positive pressure moves d toward min(d+1, 63), net-negative toward 0, zero leaves d unchanged.
parts.gate: 2304/2304 exhausted states x 9 pressures stay in [0,63] (G2a — the Coq theorem restated by exhaustion)

parts.name: timbre frozen inside tick
parts.essence: tau never changes inside tick — timbre is written only by injectors — which keeps the C2 paired arms clean and the byte's only dynamics in d.
parts.gate: G2: tau preserved EXACTLY on 3840/3840 updates
parts.failure_mode: any tau mutation inside tick would contaminate the paired-arm C2 comparison

parts.name: toroidal Moore-8 edges (R1)
parts.essence: Edges wrap, so every cell has exactly 8 neighbors and the update rule is one uniform table with no boundary special case.

parts.name: determinism contract: no Math.random in the kernel
parts.essence: mulberry32 exists only as a SEEDED caller-side generator; tick never draws randomness; same substrate + same opts is byte-identical.
parts.gate: G3: two substrates, 1000 ticks, all per-tick trace hashes byte-identical; different seed differs; static scan finds ZERO Math.random in the kernel
parts.failure_mode: a nondeterministic tick would void every experiment (determinism or it didn't happen)

parts.name: traceView canonical serialization
parts.essence: The single JSON-able view of substrate + table + tick events that G3/G6 hash and the A2UI HUD displays; expandos never enter the view and wormhole STATE is recorded, not the flag (R7).
parts.gate: an empty table is trace-equivalent to wormholes disabled; paired arms byte-equal with zero Abstain cells (G6/S2)
parts.failure_mode: R7: on the first G6 run the flag itself leaked into traces — found by the gate and receipted

parts.name: paired-arm wormholes flag
parts.essence: opts.wormholes=false disables table reads AND writes (the OFF arm); without Abstain cells the flag must not leak into dynamics at all.
parts.gate: G6/S1: ON-trace != OFF-trace (divergence tick exists); G6/S2: with zero Abstain cells ON === OFF byte-identical at all 200 ticks

parts.name: pre-registered gate predictions G0-G6
parts.essence: Each gate's prediction is written into the test header BEFORE the first run, per house law; the run records observed numbers; exit 0 iff all gates PASS.
parts.gate: honest FAILs stay in the receipt chain, never rewritten

parts.name: stone-v1 receipt chain for tests
parts.essence: A receipt without a chain is a rumor: G1-G6 seal into tests/receipts.jsonl with observed numbers, fully deterministic so a re-run rewrites identical bytes.
parts.gate: re-run produces byte-identical receipts

parts.name: honest-FAIL preservation (G4 erratum)
parts.essence: G4's pre-registered re-literal contained a hand-arithmetic error; the gate FAILS BY LETTER forever and the corrected literal is checked by a post-hoc gate G4-P2 — prediction was wrong, not the kernel; registered gates are never rewritten.
parts.gate: the registered literal is never edited post-registration
parts.failure_mode: rewriting the registered gate would be tampering with the pre-registration discipline

parts.name: two-reader negative controls
parts.essence: An independent stdlib-only reader walks registered receipt chains and must fail closed: one flipped byte in every row localizes to exactly that row (49/49), plus missing-file, wrong-tip, unknown-chain and mutated-pin-table refusals.
parts.gate: exit 0 iff every negative control was DETECTED and localized to the correct row
parts.failure_mode: any escape (tamper passing silently) is the named catastrophe this part exists to refuse

parts.name: priced empirical claims C1-C5
parts.essence: Layer-2 claims from the gifted corpus (gain of function, wormhole vs traversal, sigma criticality, phase threshold, self-repair) are pre-registered as paired arms with floors — all OPEN, honest null is a crown jewel.
parts.gate: a claim that dies dies cheap and honest with the receipt kept beside the body; a claim that lives owes a mechanism-level explanation
parts.failure_mode: C3's gifted 'proof' is receipted as decorative (the Gaussian integral yields sigma*sqrt(2pi) for ANY sigma) — only the sweep decides

parts.name: A2UI telemetry mapping
parts.essence: The live mirror: pixel = cell, tau=1 green, tau=2 red, tau=0 gray, tau=3 purple blinking on wormhole activity, 6-bit value = intensity, direct buffer-to-canvas, no log files.
parts.gate: HUD SHA stable across reload (demo/smoke screenshots receipted)
parts.evidence: SPEC.md:65-67; demo/smoke/smoke.md:17 (checklist item c: HUD sha stable across reloads, cross-runtime MATCH)

cells.expr: Moore-8 signed sum of neighbor d (pre-tick snap)
slot[d] occupied by other (x,y) with r!=0 -> term = r*sigma

layer_logic.0: The substrate is the packed byte itself: tau x d over {0..3} x {0..63} with bijection, bounds and split-channel algebra as exhaustively-tested facts.
layer_logic.1: The mechanism is tick(): a synchronous toroidal Moore-8 pressure transform plus wormhole twin-resonance events, double-buffered so neighbors come from the pre-tick grid.
layer_logic.2: The policy is the sigma scale, the wormholes ON/OFF paired-arm flag, and the pre-registration pricing law that keeps C1-C5 open until a paired arm decides.
layer_logic.3: The interface is traceView (the only serialization), the tests/receipt chain files, and the A2UI pixel mirror — no floats cross any boundary.
layer_logic.4: The evidence is G0-G6 predictions sealed before runs, stone-v1 receipts that re-run byte-identical, the preserved G4 honest-FAIL, and the two-reader's 54/54 fail-closed tamper localization.
